three_failures_identified.title: ast.Num AttributeError (Python 3.12+ incompatibility)
three_failures_identified.root_cause: muta_ext/uast2/verify.py:479 uses elif isinstance(node, stdlib_ast.Num):. ast.Num was deprecated in 3.8 and REMOVED in 3.12. Runtime here is Python 3.14.7, so stdlib_ast.Num raises AttributeError on the hot path of _numeric_literals(), crashing MathFidelityVerify. _literal_drift() (verify.py:484) calls it on both original and mutated source. The branch is marked pragma no cover - py<3.8 shim but still executes the isinstance check.
three_failures_identified.fix: Guard with getattr(stdlib_ast,'Num',()) or, since target is Python >=3.10, drop the dead py<3.8 branch entirely (ast.Constant already handles int/float). ast_math_verifier.py has the same risk (coverage 17%).

three_failures_identified.title: Bandit cost-aware wiring bug (cost-competent bandit never wired into island loop)
three_failures_identified.root_cause: operator_bandit.py fully implements the cost-aware feature (compute_cost_aware_reward line 74, OperatorBandit.update_cost_aware line 216, COST_AWARE_SCALE 1000.0, per-arm tokens accounting). However island.py::_update_operator_bandit (line 336) NEVER honors MUTALAMBDA_OPT_HEADROOM__BANDIT__ENABLED: it imports compute_operator_reward (legacy, line 342), calls bandit.update(...) (legacy, line 369), and never calls update_cost_aware / never reads ind.llm_tokens. grep -rE for HEADROOM__BANDIT|update_cost_aware|compute_cost_aware_reward|cost_aware across island.py, evolve.py, island_evolution.py, evolution_engine.py, progressive_pipeline.py, hfc_tiers.py, economic_gate.py returns matches ONLY in operator_bandit.py (definition site).
three_failures_identified.evidence: Test sets MUTALAMBDA_OPT_HEADROOM__BANDIT__ENABLED=1 with Individual(llm_tokens=10000), expects tokens==10000 and total_reward ~= 0.05/10000*1000 = 0.005. Actual: tokens==0 and total_reward=1.05 (legacy 1.0 + min(1.0, gain)). The flag and token path are dead in the island loop.
three_failures_identified.fix: In island._update_operator_bandit read the flag via optimization_flags; when enabled compute reward with compute_cost_aware_reward(improved=correct, correct=correct, delta_fitness=gain, tokens=getattr(ind,'llm_tokens',0)) and call bandit.update_cost_aware(op, reward, valid=..., improved=..., gain=..., tokens=...).

three_failures_identified.title: MicroVM sandbox: incorrect test fixture + fail-closed defect + unsealed host root
three_failures_identified.root_cause_a_fixture: Tests gate on shutil.which('bwrap') (skip if absent). bwrap IS installed (/usr/bin/bwrap, bubblewrap 0.12.0) so they do not skip. The fixture conflates 'bwrap on PATH' with 'sandbox securely functional' - not validated, so real defects surface as failures.
three_failures_identified.root_cause_b_simulated_missing: test_microvm_runner_fails_closed_when_bwrap_missing patches runners.shutil.which -> None. But MicroVMRunner.run() (runners.py:907) calls subprocess.run(['bwrap',...]) which resolves bwrap via OS PATH independently of shutil.which. Binary exists so the 'missing' scenario is never realized; candidate executes and passes. __post_init__ (runners.py:846) only warns (no raise) for enforce_ast_scan=False and run() never re-validates bwrap, decoupling warning from execution.
three_failures_identified.root_cause_c_unsealed_sandbox: _build_sandbox (runners.py:848) only --ro-bind s /usr,/bin,/lib,/lib64,/work,/dev,/proc and --tmpfs /tmp. It does NOT bind '/' read-only, so the host root remains reachable AND writable. open('/host_probe_marker','w') succeeds (correctness=1.0) - cross-language file-transfer egress boundary broken. test_microvm_build_sandbox_has_no_writable_host_bind passes only because it checks for '--bind' tokens, not the unsealed '/'.
three_failures_identified.fix: Production: add --ro-bind / / after ro-binds so host root is read-only. run() must fail closed when bwrap missing for opt-out path. Fixture: simulate truly-missing bwrap by manipulating PATH so subprocess.run cannot resolve it, or have the runner cache the bwrap path from shutil.which at construction.
